title: research-vault project binding (.research-vault.json)
description: Per-repo binding discovered by walking up from the working directory (the .editorconfig/.nvmrc pattern). Binds a repo to a vault and supplies capture defaults. The plugin ships the mechanism; every value here is repo-specific. Controlled values (domain, volatility) are validated against the vault's single taxonomy.json at load time.

vault.description: Path to (or name of) the vault this repo binds to. Wins over $RESEARCH_VAULT_PATH and the global config pointer, but not over an explicit --vault flag.

defaults.description: Capture defaults applied when this repo's agent creates vault entries.

domain.description: A controlled domain from taxonomy.json (e.g. learning, software-engineering).

topics.description: Freeform default topics for entries captured from this repo.

volatility.description: A controlled volatility tier from taxonomy.json (stable|slow|fast|volatile).

references.description: Where this repo keeps documents that cite external facts.

globs.description: Globs (repo-relative) for files the authoring skill and consumer-side check should treat as citation-bearing.

enabled.description: Whether authoring in this repo should consult-and-capture into the bound vault.
